answer: With temporal decay, reputation follows an exponential half-life, so influence persists only through sustained, reciprocated honest service. A freshly spawned sybil has negligible trusted incoming mass; EigenTrust iteration therefore assigns it near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot create credible support from an isolated vertex. Names such as reef or falcon grant no standing: the identity cannot pass consensus without earning durable trust.
